faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Assistant position at IIM Amritsar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Assistant position at IIM Amritsar is 17th August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree with an excellent academic record in Management, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or any related discipline from a recognized University/Institution is required.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant post at the Indian Institute of Management Amritsar.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Assistant position is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 25,000.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant position will primarily involve a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Research Assistant position at IIM Amritsar must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIM Amritsar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Amritsar is located in Amritsar, Punjab, with the pincode 143115.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant position at IIM Amritsar is a contractual job.
